addition.source: ESP32-C5 TRM v1.1, 2.8.2.6, p. 86, and 2.8.2.7, Registers 2.62 to 2.67, pp. 88-90: the CLIC's registers at mclicbase 0x2080_0000, which no SVD gives; clicintip[i], clicintie[i], clicintattr[i] and clicintctl[i] are the bytes of the word at 0x1000 + 4*i, which the manual says word accesses reach atomically, as IDF v6.1's clic_reg.h writes CLIC_INT_CTRL_REG(i); mintthresh is a CSR, not memory
